body:
**Describe the bug**

dask_cudf nunique gives incorrect results

**Steps/Code to reproduce bug**
```python
import dask_cudf
import cudf

df = dask_cudf.from_cudf(cudf.DataFrame({"key":[1,1],'val':[1,2]}),npartitions=1)
df.groupby(['key']).val.nunique().compute()

```

```
	val
0	1
1	1
```

**Expected behavior**
```python
df.to_dask_dataframe().groupby(['key']).val.nunique().compute()
```
```
key
1    2
Name: val, dtype: int64
```
**Environment overview (please complete the following information)**
 - Method of cuDF install: [conda]

```python
# packages in environment at /raid/vjawa/conda/conda_installation/envs/cudf_march_23:
cudf                      0.13.0a200323         py37_4667    rapidsai-nightly
dask-cudf                 0.13.0a200323         py37_4667    rapidsai-nightly
libcudf                   0.13.0a200323     cuda10.1_4667    rapidsai-nightly
dask                      2.12.0                     py_0    conda-forge
dask-core                 2.12.0                     py_0    conda-forge
dask-cuda                 0.13.0b200323           py37_73    rapidsai-nightly
dask-cudf                 0.13.0a200323         py37_4667    rapidsai-nightly
```
**Additional context**

Seems like mainline-dask may have problems that can be related:

Dask issue https://github.com/dask/dask/issues/4869
Pandas issue : https://github.com/pandas-dev/pandas/issues/26515
